BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the extension of state route number 166;amending RCW 47.17.328; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: It is the intent of the legislature thatstate route number 166 be extended to serve as an alternate state routeconnection between state route number 16 and the Southworth state ferrydock.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.17.328 and 1993 c 430 s 3 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A state highway to be known as state route number 166 isestablished as follows: Beginning at a junction with state route number 16 in the vicinitywest of Port Orchard, thence ((northeasterly to the eastern PortOrchard city limits)) easterly via Port Orchard to the Washington stateferry dock at Point Southworth.
